description: This file defines the ShippingService interface, outlining methods for managing shipping configurations, modules, quotes, and related operations within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ShippingService
classes.description: Interface for shipping-related operations such as configuration, module management, quote retrieval, and shipping calculations.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Returns a list of supported countries configured by the merchant.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Sets the list of supported countries for shipping.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping modules for a merchant.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Gets configured shipping modules for a merchant.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves a shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves shipping configuration for a merchant.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves shipping configuration for a merchant.

methods.name: removeShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: getPackagesDetails
methods.description: Provides details on package dimensions for shipping quotes.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Retrieves shipping quotes from a configured gateway.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Gets shipping configuration by module code.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom configuration for a shipping module.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Builds a shipping summary based on selected options.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Returns list of countries eligible for shipping.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if shipping is required based on cart items.
